story_overview: At a lush garden terrace, Leo and Javier hold a tense meeting with Carlos. Later, various members of the group, including Rico and Mateo, engage in a series of clandestine operations, communicating via walkie-talkies from a dark green sedan and observing targets on a city street.

Javier: Man in his 40s with a weathered face, a neatly trimmed black goatee and mustache, and short salt-and-pepper hair, wearing a light blue, short-sleeved linen shirt unbuttoned at the collar.
The Garden Terrace: Outdoor patio with a thatched roof, situated in a green, grassy tropical garden with trees.

Close-up profile shot of Javier and Leo sitting side-by-side at The Garden Terrace. Javier is speaking while Leo listens. The focus smoothly shifts from Javier to Leo. The background shows a green, grassy area with trees that are slightly out of focus.
